lines.text: A door stood open to preach the gospel in Troas, but he had no peace without Titus.
Having said goodbye to them, he went on to Galatia.
We are the aroma of Christ to God, a fragrance of life to some and death to others.
Paul says the Corinthians are a letter from Christ, written with the Spirit on tablets of human gold.
Our competence comes from God, who qualified us as ministers of a new covenant of the Spirit.
